name: fmp_sp500_constituents
description:
Current constituents of the S&P 500 index from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): symbol, name, sector and related fields.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/sp500-constituent as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
Other indexes: fmp_nasdaq_constituents, fmp_dowjones_constituents; index level: fmp_index_quote.
Example: {}
